title: Nasal carriage rate and antibiotic susceptibility pattern of Neisseria meningitidis
author: Ethiopian research team
license_note: Confirmed via CrossRef DOI metadata: dx.doi.org/10.17504/protocols.io.jfbcjin

Specimen collected in an inappropriate container
Worksheet for microbiologic testing of Neisseria meningitidis
A B C W135 X Y Z Non-Serogroupable

steps.title: Prepare the nasal swab
steps.instruction: Prepare the recommended swab for specimen collection.

substeps.instruction: Optionally moisten the swab with two drops (approximately 50 μl) of sterile physiologic saline, or use the swab dry.

steps.title: Collect nasal specimens
steps.instruction: Collect samples from both nostrils of the study participant.

substeps.instruction: Carefully insert the swab into the first nostril up to 2.5 cm from the edge of the nares.
Insert the same swab into the second nostril and repeat the sampling process.

steps.title: Transport the specimen
steps.instruction: Return the swab to its container and transport it to the laboratory immediately.

steps.title: Inoculate and incubate samples
steps.instruction: Perform sample inoculation and incubate the media.

substeps.instruction: Incubate at 37°C in 5% CO2 for 72 hours.
Monitor/evaluate the media after 24, 48, and 72 hours.

steps.title: Perform antibiotic susceptibility testing
steps.instruction: Conduct susceptibility testing on the isolates, including zone diameter testing for the drugs tested.
